biotools.summary: DspikeIn is a framework for absolute abundance profiling of microbial communities, enabling the resolution of compositional biases and revealing patterns masked in relative abundance data. It enhances ecological resolution and cross-study comparability, as evidenced by its use in uncovering host-specific microbial patterns.
